title: Check row
description: One row of the checks as returned by buildCheckRows(): what a check observed and its pass, warn, fail or not-available status. summary is the plain-language result shown in the Checks performed list and, through buildVerdictGroupLines(), in the verdict card group lines; it never names a raw API. result (the raw observed value) and finding (the server message) appear only in each row's details.

summary.description: Plain-language result: the row text in Checks performed and the group line on the verdict card.
